summary: Tips for cross-platform PowerShell modules: use $IsWindows, $IsLinux, $IsMacOS, $IsCoreCLR or $PSVersionTable checks (defining $IsWindows for 5.1), and avoid Windows-only cmdlets like Get-WmiObject. Use .NET APIs supported on target platforms, test on multiple platforms and document requirements.
questions: How do I write a PowerShell module that works on both Windows and Linux?
How can my module tell if it's running on PowerShell 5.1 or 7?
Why is $IsWindows undefined in Windows PowerShell 5.1?
Which cmdlets should I avoid in cross-platform modules?

answer_card.title: Writing cross-platform PowerShell modules
